title: 日复一日的远航
logline: 以写实真人纪录风格呈现老渔妇三十年每日天未亮出海劳作的日常，诠释「重复本身是一种勇气」的核心主张，最终落点至船用动力产品的陪伴价值。

shots.narrationEn: At the first hint of dawn, she is already by her boat.
shots.visual: Dawn breaks over a quiet, misty fishing port, an elderly fisherwoman unties the mooring rope of her small wooden fishing boat.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉静克制，语速偏缓，『已』字重读，气息沉稳带晨雾滞涩感，开头留半秒气口

shots.narrationZh: 三十年的网，补过上百回。
shots.narrationEn: The fishing net has been mended hundreds of times over thirty years.
shots.visual: She crouches on the boat deck, carefully checking each mesh of the worn, patched fishing net.
shots.ttsDirection: 平缓厚重，语速适中，『上百回』重读，气息下沉带岁月沉淀暖意，尾音稍收

shots.narrationEn: The engine starts, and she heads out to sea.
shots.visual: She pulls the starter cord of the weathered outboard motor, which sputters to life with a low rumble.
shots.ttsDirection: 利落笃定，语速稍快，『响』字重读，气息短促有力，无拖沓尾音

shots.narrationEn: Day after day is a voyage in itself.
shots.visual: Her small boat cuts through the calm morning sea, sailing past the breakwater as the golden sun rises over the horizon.
shots.ttsDirection: 克制有力，语速中等偏缓，『远航』重读，气息沉稳带力量感，尾音稳收

shots.narrationEn: Accompanying the courage in every daily routine.
shots.visual: Close-up of the durable outboard motor mounted on the boat, with the brand logo and product name clearly visible.
shots.ttsDirection: 温和收束，语速放缓，『勇气』重读，气息轻柔带暖意，尾音自然落定
